verdict.rationale: Poly ships first-party AI connectors. A hosted official MCP server (OAuth, streamable HTTP) lets external assistants search, fetch and edit Poly files, and a runtime probe confirmed it is live. An official Claude Code plugin loads Poly memory and connects the MCP server, a `poly-cli` agent skill is available, and docs mention plugins for Claude, ChatGPT and VS Code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of these connectors in use, and setup documentation for the ChatGPT and VS Code plugins beyond a one-line mention.
